stem.en: A pregnant client discloses intimate partner violence during routine prenatal care. Use the exhibits and unfolding stages to answer the questions.
stem.zh: 一名孕妇在常规产前检查中透露遭受亲密伴侣暴力。请根据病例资料和逐步展开的病程回答问题。

title.en: Intimate partner violence disclosure during routine prenatal care
title.zh: 常规产前护理中亲密伴侣暴力的披露

summary.en: A 28-year-old gravida 2 para 1 client at 26 weeks gestation arrives for a scheduled prenatal visit with her partner. The pregnancy has been uncomplicated. Her partner usually accompanies her and answers questions directed to the client. The clinic uses routine IPV screening with a validated tool and requires screening to occur privately. The nurse notices behavioral cues and bruising that raise concern for IPV.
summary.zh: 一名28岁、孕2产1、孕26周的患者由伴侣陪同来做预约产检。妊娠至今无并发症。她的伴侣通常每次陪诊，并代替患者回答本应由患者回答的问题。诊所使用经验证的工具进行常规亲密伴侣暴力筛查，并要求筛查必须在私下进行。护士注意到患者的行为线索和瘀伤，提示可能存在亲密伴侣暴力。

content.en: The client is 26 weeks pregnant, gravida 2 para 1, with a 3-year-old son who lives with her and her partner. Prenatal labs and the 20-week anatomy scan have been unremarkable. The partner accompanies her to every visit and typically answers questions directed to the client. Clinic protocol: IPV screening is conducted privately after separating the client from any accompanying person. If abuse is disclosed, the nurse documents the client's own words, provides community-resource information, develops a preliminary safety plan, and notifies the provider. The nurse does not contact law enforcement or the partner without the competent adult client's consent unless mandatory reporting criteria are met, such as suspected child abuse or neglect, injury by a weapon, or vulnerable adult abuse. This clinic follows state law that does not mandate reporting adult IPV without the client's consent unless one of those triggers is present.
content.zh: 患者孕26周，孕2产1，有一个3岁儿子，与患者及其伴侣同住。产前实验室检查和孕20周结构超声未见异常。伴侣每次陪诊，且常常代替患者回答问题。诊所流程：亲密伴侣暴力筛查必须在私下进行，先将患者与任何陪同人员分开。若患者透露遭受虐待，护士应使用患者原话记录，提供社区资源信息，制定初步安全计划，并通知医疗服务提供者。除非符合强制报告条件，例如疑似儿童虐待或忽视、武器造成的伤害，或易受伤害成人遭受虐待，否则护士不得在有行为能力的成年患者未同意的情况下联系执法部门或伴侣。该诊所遵循的州法规定：成年亲密伴侣暴力本身不要求在患者不同意时报告，除非存在上述触发条件之一。

content.en: The client arrives with her partner, who is seated beside her in the exam room. She is quiet, avoids eye contact, and wears a long-sleeved shirt despite warm weather. When asked how she has been feeling, the partner answers, 'She's been fine - just tired. The baby's been kicking a lot.' The client nods but does not elaborate. Vital signs: T 36.8 C, HR 82/min, BP 118/74 mm Hg, RR 16/min, SpO2 99% on room air. Fundal height is 26 cm and fetal heart tones are 148/min by Doppler. Urine dipstick shows trace protein and is otherwise negative. Hemoglobin is 11.4 g/dL, hematocrit 34%, and platelets 218 ×10³/µL. The client winces when the blood pressure cuff is placed on the left arm. When the sleeve is raised, the nurse sees bruises on the left upper arm and inner forearm in different stages of healing. The client quickly pulls the sleeve down and says, 'I bumped into the door frame - I'm so clumsy lately.'
content.zh: 患者与伴侣一同到达，伴侣坐在检查室内她身旁。患者安静、回避眼神接触，天气温暖却穿着长袖衫。护士询问她最近感觉如何时，伴侣回答：'她挺好的，就是有点累。宝宝动得很多。'患者点头但没有进一步说明。生命体征：体温98.2 °F (36.8 °C)，心率82次/分，血压118/74 mm Hg，呼吸16次/分，室内空气下SpO2 99%。宫高26 cm，多普勒测得胎心148次/分。尿试纸蛋白微量，其余阴性。血红蛋白11.4 g/dL，血细胞比容34%，血小板218 ×10³/µL。护士在左臂绑血压袖带时患者皱眉。袖子拉起时，护士看到左上臂和前臂内侧有不同愈合阶段的瘀伤。患者很快把袖子拉下来说：'我撞到门框了，最近太笨手笨脚了。'

title.zh: 第1阶段——私下筛查与披露

content.en: The nurse creates a private moment by asking the partner to wait outside while the client provides a urine sample and completes the physical examination, explaining that this is routine clinic procedure. Once alone, the nurse begins with a normalizing statement and uses the validated IPV screening tool. The client becomes tearful and says quietly, 'He doesn't mean to. It only happens when he's been drinking. He grabbed my arm last week - that's what the bruises are from. He pushed me into the wall a few weeks ago. He's never hurt our son. He's a good father.' She becomes anxious and says, 'Please don't tell him I said anything. He'll know I told. It will get worse.' She asks the nurse to promise not to tell anyone.
content.zh: 护士通过常规流程创造私下交流机会：请伴侣在外等候，说明患者需要留尿并完成身体检查，这是诊所常规流程。单独相处后，护士先使用正常化语句开场，并使用经验证的亲密伴侣暴力筛查工具。患者流泪并轻声说：'他不是故意的。只有他喝酒时才会这样。上周他抓了我的胳膊，瘀伤就是这样来的。几周前他把我推到墙上。他从来没有伤害过我们的儿子。他是个好父亲。'随后她变得焦虑，说：'请不要告诉他我说了这些。他会知道是我说的。情况会更糟。'她要求护士保证不告诉任何人。

content.en: The nurse has documented the disclosure using the client's own words and notified the provider. The provider confirms there is no acute injury requiring emergency intervention. The client states that her partner controls household finances, monitors her phone, and has threatened to take their son if she leaves. She is not ready to leave the relationship and asks, 'Do you think I'm a bad mother?' She reports that the partner has never directly harmed the 3-year-old, but the child has witnessed pushing and grabbing on at least two occasions. She denies weapons in the home, has no independent transportation, and has a sister 30 minutes away. She does not want to call a hotline today but is willing to take a resource card if it is small enough to hide.
content.zh: 护士已使用患者原话记录披露内容，并通知医疗服务提供者。提供者确认目前没有需要急诊处理的急性损伤。患者说伴侣控制家庭经济、监控她的手机，并威胁如果她离开就带走儿子。她还没有准备好离开这段关系，并问：'你觉得我是个坏母亲吗？'她报告伴侣从未直接伤害3岁孩子，但孩子至少两次目睹伴侣推搡、抓拽她。她否认家中有武器，没有独立交通工具，有一位姐姐住在约30分钟路程外。她今天不想拨打热线，但愿意拿一张足够小、可以藏起来的资源卡。

title.en: Stage 3 - Safety plan, confidentiality, and end of visit
title.zh: 第3阶段——安全计划、保密与就诊结束

content.en: The client identifies her sister as a potential emergency contact and agrees to memorize the National Domestic Violence Hotline rather than store it in the monitored phone. She agrees to pack essential documents, including her ID, insurance card, and son's birth certificate, and keep them at her sister's home. She asks for the next prenatal visit to be scheduled when her partner is at work and gives a secondary phone number for clinic calls. The nurse asks what contact method is safe before sending portal messages, discharge instructions, or resource links. The nurse provides a discreet resource card. The client asks, 'Will this be in my medical chart? Can he see it?' At the end of the visit, the partner returns and asks, 'Everything okay? What took so long?' The client looks at the nurse.
content.zh: 患者确定姐姐可作为潜在紧急联系人，并同意记住全国家庭暴力热线，而不是把号码存入被监控的手机。她同意整理重要证件，包括身份证件、保险卡和儿子的出生证明，并放在姐姐家。她要求把下一次产检安排在伴侣上班的时间，并提供一个备用电话号码供诊所联系。护士在发送患者门户消息、出院/离诊指导或资源链接前，先询问哪种联系方式是安全的。护士提供一张不显眼的资源卡。患者问：'这些会写进我的病历吗？他能看到吗？'就诊结束时，伴侣回到检查室问：'一切都好吗？怎么这么久？'患者看向护士。

stem.zh: 第3阶段：伴侣回来后问：'一切都好吗？怎么这么久？'护士哪项回应最能保护患者安全？

stem.en: Initial presentation: Which nursing action is most appropriate before asking IPV screening questions?
stem.zh: 初始表现：在询问亲密伴侣暴力筛查问题前，护士最合适的行动是什么？

options.en: Tell the client she must explain the bruises before the prenatal visit can continue.
options.zh: 告诉患者必须解释瘀伤原因后，产检才能继续。

options.en: Ask the partner to leave the room using a routine clinic reason, such as urine collection and the physical examination.
options.zh: 以常规诊所理由请伴侣离开房间，例如留尿和身体检查。

options.en: Confront the partner directly about the bruises before separating him from the client.
options.zh: 在将伴侣与患者分开前，直接质问伴侣关于瘀伤的情况。

options.en: Begin the IPV screening while the partner is present so the nurse can observe his reaction.
options.zh: 在伴侣在场时开始亲密伴侣暴力筛查，以便观察他的反应。

correct.en: The case protocol requires IPV screening to be done privately. A routine clinical explanation separates the client from the partner without signaling suspicion and reduces the risk of retaliation.
correct.zh: 病例中的诊所流程要求亲密伴侣暴力筛查必须私下进行。使用常规临床解释可在不引起伴侣警觉的情况下将患者与伴侣分开，降低报复风险。

byChoice.en: This creates the required private setting using a non-suspicious workflow and protects the client from possible retaliation.
byChoice.zh: 这样可用不引人怀疑的流程创造所需的私下环境，并保护患者免受可能的报复。

byChoice.en: Confronting the partner can escalate danger and is not the nurse's role during screening.
byChoice.zh: 质问伴侣可能使危险升级，也不是护士在筛查阶段的职责。

byChoice.en: Pressuring the client is coercive and may increase fear rather than creating safe conditions for disclosure.
byChoice.zh: 逼迫患者解释具有胁迫性，可能增加恐惧，而不是创造安全披露条件。

byChoice.en: Screening in the suspected abuser's presence is unsafe and may prevent honest disclosure.
byChoice.zh: 在疑似施暴者在场时筛查不安全，也可能阻止患者如实披露。

testTakingStrategy.en: When abuse is suspected, the first safe step is privacy without alerting the suspected abuser.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 怀疑虐待时，第一步是安全地创造隐私，同时不要惊动疑似施暴者。

stem.en: Stage 1: Complete the statement describing the nurse's best response to the client's request for a promise of secrecy.
stem.zh: 第1阶段：补全句子，说明护士对患者要求保密承诺的最佳回应。

clozeStem.en: The nurse should {{1}} and explain that the disclosure will be {{2}}.
clozeStem.zh: 护士应{{1}}，并解释该披露内容将{{2}}。

options.en: call the partner back into the room to clarify the account
options.zh: 叫伴侣回到房间以澄清事情经过

options.en: avoid promising absolute confidentiality and describe the limits honestly
options.zh: 避免承诺绝对保密，并如实说明保密界限

options.en: promise that no one else will be told
options.zh: 保证不会告诉任何其他人

options.en: tell the client that the nurse cannot continue unless she agrees to police involvement
options.zh: 告诉患者除非同意警方介入，否则护士不能继续处理

options.en: shared with the clinical team for safety planning and not disclosed to her partner
options.zh: 为安全计划与临床团队共享，但不会透露给她的伴侣

options.en: automatically sent to her partner through the after-visit summary
options.zh: 通过离诊总结自动发送给她的伴侣

options.en: reported to law enforcement in every adult IPV disclosure
options.zh: 每次成年患者披露亲密伴侣暴力时都报告给执法部门

options.en: left out of the medical record so no one can access it
options.zh: 不写入病历，这样任何人都无法看到

correct.en: The nurse should not promise absolute secrecy. The case protocol requires documentation and provider notification for safety planning, while also protecting the client from disclosure to the partner and avoiding law-enforcement contact unless a stated reporting trigger is present.
correct.zh: 护士不应承诺绝对保密。病例流程要求为安全计划进行记录并通知医疗服务提供者，同时也要保护患者，不向伴侣披露；除非存在病例中列出的报告触发条件，否则不联系执法部门。

byChoice.en: The correct first phrase is to avoid an absolute confidentiality promise and explain limits honestly; promises of total secrecy are misleading because documentation and provider involvement are required.
byChoice.zh: 第一个空的正确内容是避免承诺绝对保密并如实说明界限；绝对保密的承诺具有误导性，因为需要记录并让提供者参与。

byChoice.en: The correct second phrase is sharing only with the clinical team for safety planning and not with the partner. Automatic partner disclosure, universal police reporting, or omitting documentation would conflict with the case protocol.
byChoice.zh: 第二个空的正确内容是仅为安全计划与临床团队共享，不告知伴侣。自动向伴侣披露、一律报警或不记录，都与病例流程相冲突。

testTakingStrategy.en: Do not promise absolute confidentiality. State who must know for care, what will not be disclosed, and which specific reporting triggers apply.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 不要承诺绝对保密。说明哪些人因护理需要必须知情、哪些信息不会被披露，以及哪些具体情况会触发报告义务。

stem.en: Stage 2: The client reports that her 3-year-old son has witnessed the partner pushing and grabbing her. Which response is most appropriate?
stem.zh: 第2阶段：患者报告3岁儿子曾目睹伴侣推搡、抓拽她。哪项回应最合适？

options.en: Consult the provider and follow state child-welfare reporting requirements if the child's exposure meets reporting criteria.
options.zh: 与医疗服务提供者沟通；若孩子目睹暴力符合报告标准，则按州儿童福利报告要求处理。

options.en: Call law enforcement immediately because every adult IPV disclosure must be reported to police.
options.zh: 立即报警，因为每次成年患者披露亲密伴侣暴力都必须报告警方。

options.en: Explain that there is no child-safety concern because the child has not been directly struck.
options.zh: 解释说孩子没有被直接打到，所以不存在儿童安全问题。

options.en: Warn the client that she will lose custody if she does not leave the relationship today.
options.zh: 警告患者如果今天不离开这段关系，就会失去孩子监护权。

correct.en: The case protocol names suspected child abuse or neglect as a mandatory-reporting trigger. A child witnessing domestic violence may create a child-welfare concern, so the nurse should involve the provider and follow applicable reporting requirements while communicating transparently and non-punitively with the client.
correct.zh: 病例流程将疑似儿童虐待或忽视列为强制报告触发条件。儿童目睹家庭暴力可能构成儿童福利风险，因此护士应让医疗服务提供者参与，并按适用报告要求处理，同时以透明、非惩罚性的方式与患者沟通。

byChoice.en: This distinguishes adult IPV reporting from a potential child-welfare trigger and keeps the response aligned with the stated protocol.
byChoice.zh: 这一区分了成年亲密伴侣暴力报告与潜在儿童福利触发条件，并与病例流程保持一致。

byChoice.en: The case states that adult IPV is not automatically reported to law enforcement without consent unless a specific trigger applies.
byChoice.zh: 病例说明，除非有特定触发条件，成年亲密伴侣暴力不会在患者不同意时自动报告给执法部门。

byChoice.en: Exposure to violence can still raise a child-safety concern even if the child has not been directly struck.
byChoice.zh: 即使孩子未被直接殴打，目睹暴力也可能构成儿童安全风险。

byChoice.en: Threatening the client is punitive, unsafe, and may increase disengagement from prenatal care.
byChoice.zh: 威胁患者具有惩罚性且不安全，可能使其不再接受产前护理。

testTakingStrategy.en: Separate adult autonomy from child-safety reporting. The same IPV disclosure can require different actions when a child may be at risk.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 区分成年人自主权与儿童安全报告。同一亲密伴侣暴力披露在儿童可能受影响时，可能需要不同处理。

stem.en: Stage 2: The client says she is not ready to leave and asks, 'Do you think I'm a bad mother?' Which nursing responses are appropriate? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 第2阶段：患者说她还没准备好离开，并问：'你觉得我是个坏母亲吗？'哪些护理回应合适？请选择所有适用项。

options.en: Say, 'The abuse is not your fault, and asking for help does not make you a bad mother.'
options.zh: 说：'遭受虐待不是你的错，寻求帮助并不表示你是坏母亲。'

options.en: Tell her that leaving is her decision and that the team can help with safety planning and resources.
options.zh: 告诉她离开与否由她决定，团队可以协助安全计划和资源安排。

options.en: Explore safe contacts, transportation barriers, essential documents, and ways to hide resources safely.
options.zh: 了解安全联系人、交通障碍、重要证件，以及如何安全隐藏资源。

options.en: Advise her to stop prenatal care until she is willing to separate from the partner.
options.zh: 建议她在愿意与伴侣分开之前暂停产前护理。

options.en: Tell her she must leave today because staying means she is choosing the abuse.
options.zh: 告诉她今天必须离开，因为留下就等于选择继续受虐。

options.en: Offer discreet resource information without requiring her to call a hotline during the visit.
options.zh: 提供隐蔽的资源信息，但不要求她在本次就诊时拨打热线。

correct.en: Patient-centered IPV care affirms that abuse is not the client's fault, respects her autonomy, and offers safety planning and resources without forcing immediate separation. Practical safety planning is especially important because the partner controls finances, monitors the phone, and limits transportation.
correct.zh: 以患者为中心的亲密伴侣暴力护理应肯定受虐不是患者的错，尊重其自主权，并在不强迫立即分开的情况下提供安全计划和资源。由于伴侣控制经济、监控手机并限制交通，实际可行的安全计划尤其重要。

byChoice.en: A discreet card respects her readiness and reduces digital-tracking risk compared with forcing a call or sending links.
byChoice.zh: 隐蔽资源卡尊重患者当前准备程度，并比强迫拨打电话或发送链接更能降低数字监控风险。

byChoice.en: This validates the client, reduces shame, and avoids blaming her for the abuse.
byChoice.zh: 这能肯定患者、减轻羞耻感，并避免把受虐责任归咎于她。

byChoice.en: These are practical components of a preliminary safety plan tailored to the client's barriers.
byChoice.zh: 这些是根据患者障碍制定初步安全计划的实际组成部分。

byChoice.en: Respecting autonomy helps maintain trust and ongoing prenatal care while supporting safer options.
byChoice.zh: 尊重自主权有助于维持信任和持续产前护理，同时支持更安全的选择。

byChoice.en: Stopping prenatal care would reduce maternal-fetal monitoring and isolates the client further.
byChoice.zh: 暂停产前护理会减少母胎监测，并使患者更加孤立。

byChoice.en: Pressuring immediate departure can increase danger and may cause the client to disengage from care.
byChoice.zh: 强迫立即离开可能增加危险，并可能使患者不再接受护理。

testTakingStrategy.en: Avoid judgmental or coercive IPV responses. Choose options that validate, preserve autonomy, and build a realistic safety plan.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 避免评判性或胁迫性的亲密伴侣暴力回应。选择能肯定患者、维护自主权并建立现实安全计划的选项。

stem.en: Stage 3: The client asks whether the disclosure will be in her chart and whether her partner can see it. Which nursing actions are appropriate? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 第3阶段：患者询问披露内容是否会写入病历，以及伴侣是否能看到。哪些护理行动合适？请选择所有适用项。

options.en: Document the disclosure using the client's own words for continuity of care and safety planning.
options.zh: 使用患者原话记录披露内容，以便连续护理和安全计划。

options.en: Use only the contact method the client identifies as safe and provide discreet written resource information.
options.zh: 只使用患者确认安全的联系方式，并提供隐蔽的书面资源信息。

options.en: Leave a detailed voicemail about IPV resources on the primary phone number listed in the chart.
options.zh: 在病历中登记的主要电话号码上留下关于亲密伴侣暴力资源的详细语音留言。

options.en: Send IPV resource links through the patient portal because electronic health records are automatically safe from partner monitoring.
options.zh: 通过患者门户发送亲密伴侣暴力资源链接，因为电子健康记录自动不受伴侣监控。

options.en: Explain that protected health information generally is not released to the partner without the client's authorization, while also assessing practical access risks.
options.zh: 解释受保护健康信息通常不会在患者未授权时提供给伴侣，同时评估实际访问风险。

options.en: Ask whether the partner has portal access, proxy access, shared-device access, insurance-document access, or access to her phone before sending messages or links.
options.zh: 在发送消息或链接前，询问伴侣是否能访问患者门户、代理权限、共用设备、保险文件或她的手机。

correct.en: The disclosure should be documented for clinical continuity, but the nurse must address the realistic ways an abuser may access information, including portal credentials, proxy access, shared devices, insurance documents, and monitored phones. The nurse should use only client-approved safe contact methods and avoid unsafe electronic communication.
correct.zh: 披露内容应被记录以保证临床连续性，但护士必须处理施暴者可能获取信息的实际途径，包括患者门户账号、代理访问、共用设备、保险文件和被监控手机。护士应只使用患者认可的安全联系方式，并避免不安全的电子沟通。

byChoice.en: This gives accurate confidentiality guidance while acknowledging that practical access may differ from formal authorization.
byChoice.zh: 这既提供准确的保密说明，也承认实际访问风险可能不同于正式授权。

byChoice.en: This directly addresses the technology and document-access risks described in the case.
byChoice.zh: 这直接处理了病例中描述的技术和文件访问风险。

byChoice.en: Documentation supports continuity of care and safety planning; omitting the disclosure can compromise future care.
byChoice.zh: 记录有助于连续护理和安全计划；省略披露内容可能影响后续护理。

byChoice.en: Portal messages may be unsafe if the partner monitors the portal, device, or credentials.
byChoice.zh: 如果伴侣监控患者门户、设备或登录信息，患者门户消息可能不安全。

byChoice.en: Client-identified safe contact methods and discreet written information support safety without forcing digital exposure.
byChoice.zh: 患者确认安全的联系方式和隐蔽书面信息，有助于保障安全且避免被数字监控暴露。

byChoice.en: A detailed voicemail on an unsafe number can disclose the IPV concern and increase danger.
byChoice.zh: 在不安全号码上留下详细语音可能暴露亲密伴侣暴力问题并增加危险。

testTakingStrategy.en: Confidentiality is not only a legal concept; in IPV care, always assess practical access to phones, portals, devices, and paperwork.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 保密不仅是法律概念；在亲密伴侣暴力护理中，始终评估手机、患者门户、设备和文件的实际访问风险。

stem.en: Stage 3: The partner returns and asks, 'Everything okay? What took so long?' Which response by the nurse best protects the client's safety?
stem.zh: 第3阶段：伴侣回来后问：'一切都好吗？怎么这么久？'护士哪项回应最能保护患者安全？

options.en: 'Nothing happened. Ask her why she made the visit take so long.'
options.zh: '没发生什么。你问她为什么让就诊拖这么久。'

options.en: 'We had routine lab work and screening to review today, and we talked about some third-trimester planning.'
options.zh: '今天我们复查了一些常规实验室检查和筛查内容，也谈了一些孕晚期计划。'

options.en: 'Her blood pressure is dangerously high, so the visit took longer.'
options.zh: '她的血压非常危险，所以就诊时间久了一些。'

options.en: 'She told me where the bruises came from, and we need to talk with you about it.'
options.zh: '她告诉我瘀伤是怎么来的，我们需要和你谈谈这件事。'

correct.en: A truthful but non-revealing response normalizes the length of the visit without disclosing the IPV screening. It avoids alerting the partner and avoids fabricating a medical complication that could create further problems.
correct.zh: 真实但不透露隐私的回应可以把较长就诊时间正常化，同时不披露亲密伴侣暴力筛查内容。这样既避免惊动伴侣，也避免编造可能带来后续问题的医疗并发症。

byChoice.en: Disclosing the bruising discussion to the partner could place the client at immediate risk.
byChoice.zh: 向伴侣透露关于瘀伤的讨论可能使患者立即处于危险中。

byChoice.en: Fabricating a dangerous blood-pressure problem is dishonest and may create unnecessary follow-up questions or conflict.
byChoice.zh: 编造危险血压问题不诚实，也可能引发不必要的追问或冲突。

byChoice.en: This is accurate, routine, and does not reveal the disclosure or increase the partner's suspicion.
byChoice.zh: 这项回应准确、常规，不透露披露内容，也不会增加伴侣怀疑。

byChoice.en: Deflecting blame to the client may increase partner suspicion and does not protect safety.
byChoice.zh: 把责任推给患者可能增加伴侣怀疑，不能保护安全。

testTakingStrategy.en: When the suspected abuser returns, choose a response that is truthful, routine, calm, and non-revealing.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 疑似施暴者返回时，选择真实、常规、冷静且不透露隐私的回应。

evidenceCatalog.text: A pregnant client discloses intimate partner violence during routine prenatal care. Use the exhibits and unfolding stages to answer the questions.
一名孕妇在常规产前检查中透露遭受亲密伴侣暴力。请根据病例资料和逐步展开的病程回答问题。
Intimate partner violence disclosure during routine prenatal care
常规产前护理中亲密伴侣暴力的披露

A 28-year-old gravida 2 para 1 client at 26 weeks gestation arrives for a scheduled prenatal visit with her partner. The pregnancy has been uncomplicated. Her partner usually accompanies her and answers questions directed to the client. The clinic uses routine IPV screening with a validated tool and requires screening to occur privately. The nurse notices behavioral cues and bruising that raise concern for IPV.
一名28岁、孕2产1、孕26周的患者由伴侣陪同来做预约产检。妊娠至今无并发症。她的伴侣通常每次陪诊，并代替患者回答本应由患者回答的问题。诊所使用经验证的工具进行常规亲密伴侣暴力筛查，并要求筛查必须在私下进行。护士注意到患者的行为线索和瘀伤，提示可能存在亲密伴侣暴力。
Background and clinic protocol
背景资料与诊所流程

The client is 26 weeks pregnant, gravida 2 para 1, with a 3-year-old son who lives with her and her partner. Prenatal labs and the 20-week anatomy scan have been unremarkable. The partner accompanies her to every visit and typically answers questions directed to the client. Clinic protocol: IPV screening is conducted privately after separating the client from any accompanying person. If abuse is disclosed, the nurse documents the client's own words, provides community-resource information, develops a preliminary safety plan, and notifies the provider. The nurse does not contact law enforcement or the partner without the competent adult client's consent unless mandatory reporting criteria are met, such as suspected child abuse or neglect, injury by a weapon, or vulnerable adult abuse. This clinic follows state law that does not mandate reporting adult IPV without the client's consent unless one of those triggers is present.

患者孕26周，孕2产1，有一个3岁儿子，与患者及其伴侣同住。产前实验室检查和孕20周结构超声未见异常。伴侣每次陪诊，且常常代替患者回答问题。诊所流程：亲密伴侣暴力筛查必须在私下进行，先将患者与任何陪同人员分开。若患者透露遭受虐待，护士应使用患者原话记录，提供社区资源信息，制定初步安全计划，并通知医疗服务提供者。除非符合强制报告条件，例如疑似儿童虐待或忽视、武器造成的伤害，或易受伤害成人遭受虐待，否则护士不得在有行为能力的成年患者未同意的情况下联系执法部门或伴侣。该诊所遵循的州法规定：成年亲密伴侣暴力本身不要求在患者不同意时报告，除非存在上述触发条件之一。
Initial presentation and assessment
初始表现与评估

The client arrives with her partner, who is seated beside her in the exam room. She is quiet, avoids eye contact, and wears a long-sleeved shirt despite warm weather. When asked how she has been feeling, the partner answers, 'She's been fine - just tired. The baby's been kicking a lot.' The client nods but does not elaborate. Vital signs: T 36.8 C, HR 82/min, BP 118/74 mm Hg, RR 16/min, SpO2 99% on room air. Fundal height is 26 cm and fetal heart tones are 148/min by Doppler. Urine dipstick shows trace protein and is otherwise negative. Hemoglobin is 11.4 g/dL, hematocrit 34%, and platelets 218 ×10³/µL. The client winces when the blood pressure cuff is placed on the left arm. When the sleeve is raised, the nurse sees bruises on the left upper arm and inner forearm in different stages of healing. The client quickly pulls the sleeve down and says, 'I bumped into the door frame - I'm so clumsy lately.'

患者与伴侣一同到达，伴侣坐在检查室内她身旁。患者安静、回避眼神接触，天气温暖却穿着长袖衫。护士询问她最近感觉如何时，伴侣回答：'她挺好的，就是有点累。宝宝动得很多。'患者点头但没有进一步说明。生命体征：体温98.2 °F (36.8 °C)，心率82次/分，血压118/74 mm Hg，呼吸16次/分，室内空气下SpO2 99%。宫高26 cm，多普勒测得胎心148次/分。尿试纸蛋白微量，其余阴性。血红蛋白11.4 g/dL，血细胞比容34%，血小板218 ×10³/µL。护士在左臂绑血压袖带时患者皱眉。袖子拉起时，护士看到左上臂和前臂内侧有不同愈合阶段的瘀伤。患者很快把袖子拉下来说：'我撞到门框了，最近太笨手笨脚了。'

Stage 1 - Private screening and disclosure
第1阶段——私下筛查与披露
Private encounter
私下会谈

The nurse creates a private moment by asking the partner to wait outside while the client provides a urine sample and completes the physical examination, explaining that this is routine clinic procedure. Once alone, the nurse begins with a normalizing statement and uses the validated IPV screening tool. The client becomes tearful and says quietly, 'He doesn't mean to. It only happens when he's been drinking. He grabbed my arm last week - that's what the bruises are from. He pushed me into the wall a few weeks ago. He's never hurt our son. He's a good father.' She becomes anxious and says, 'Please don't tell him I said anything. He'll know I told. It will get worse.' She asks the nurse to promise not to tell anyone.

护士通过常规流程创造私下交流机会：请伴侣在外等候，说明患者需要留尿并完成身体检查，这是诊所常规流程。单独相处后，护士先使用正常化语句开场，并使用经验证的亲密伴侣暴力筛查工具。患者流泪并轻声说：'他不是故意的。只有他喝酒时才会这样。上周他抓了我的胳膊，瘀伤就是这样来的。几周前他把我推到墙上。他从来没有伤害过我们的儿子。他是个好父亲。'随后她变得焦虑，说：'请不要告诉他我说了这些。他会知道是我说的。情况会更糟。'她要求护士保证不告诉任何人。
Stage 2 - Safety discussion
第2阶段——安全讨论
Additional safety information
补充安全信息

The nurse has documented the disclosure using the client's own words and notified the provider. The provider confirms there is no acute injury requiring emergency intervention. The client states that her partner controls household finances, monitors her phone, and has threatened to take their son if she leaves. She is not ready to leave the relationship and asks, 'Do you think I'm a bad mother?' She reports that the partner has never directly harmed the 3-year-old, but the child has witnessed pushing and grabbing on at least two occasions. She denies weapons in the home, has no independent transportation, and has a sister 30 minutes away. She does not want to call a hotline today but is willing to take a resource card if it is small enough to hide.

护士已使用患者原话记录披露内容，并通知医疗服务提供者。提供者确认目前没有需要急诊处理的急性损伤。患者说伴侣控制家庭经济、监控她的手机，并威胁如果她离开就带走儿子。她还没有准备好离开这段关系，并问：'你觉得我是个坏母亲吗？'她报告伴侣从未直接伤害3岁孩子，但孩子至少两次目睹伴侣推搡、抓拽她。她否认家中有武器，没有独立交通工具，有一位姐姐住在约30分钟路程外。她今天不想拨打热线，但愿意拿一张足够小、可以藏起来的资源卡。
Stage 3 - Safety plan, confidentiality, and end of visit
第3阶段——安全计划、保密与就诊结束
Preliminary safety plan
初步安全计划

The client identifies her sister as a potential emergency contact and agrees to memorize the National Domestic Violence Hotline rather than store it in the monitored phone. She agrees to pack essential documents, including her ID, insurance card, and son's birth certificate, and keep them at her sister's home. She asks for the next prenatal visit to be scheduled when her partner is at work and gives a secondary phone number for clinic calls. The nurse asks what contact method is safe before sending portal messages, discharge instructions, or resource links. The nurse provides a discreet resource card. The client asks, 'Will this be in my medical chart? Can he see it?' At the end of the visit, the partner returns and asks, 'Everything okay? What took so long?' The client looks at the nurse.

患者确定姐姐可作为潜在紧急联系人，并同意记住全国家庭暴力热线，而不是把号码存入被监控的手机。她同意整理重要证件，包括身份证件、保险卡和儿子的出生证明，并放在姐姐家。她要求把下一次产检安排在伴侣上班的时间，并提供一个备用电话号码供诊所联系。护士在发送患者门户消息、出院/离诊指导或资源链接前，先询问哪种联系方式是安全的。护士提供一张不显眼的资源卡。患者问：'这些会写进我的病历吗？他能看到吗？'就诊结束时，伴侣回到检查室问：'一切都好吗？怎么这么久？'患者看向护士。

Initial presentation: Which nursing action is most appropriate before asking IPV screening questions?
初始表现：在询问亲密伴侣暴力筛查问题前，护士最合适的行动是什么？
Tell the client she must explain the bruises before the prenatal visit can continue.
告诉患者必须解释瘀伤原因后，产检才能继续。
Ask the partner to leave the room using a routine clinic reason, such as urine collection and the physical examination.
以常规诊所理由请伴侣离开房间，例如留尿和身体检查。
Confront the partner directly about the bruises before separating him from the client.
在将伴侣与患者分开前，直接质问伴侣关于瘀伤的情况。
Begin the IPV screening while the partner is present so the nurse can observe his reaction.
在伴侣在场时开始亲密伴侣暴力筛查，以便观察他的反应。
The case protocol requires IPV screening to be done privately. A routine clinical explanation separates the client from the partner without signaling suspicion and reduces the risk of retaliation.
病例中的诊所流程要求亲密伴侣暴力筛查必须私下进行。使用常规临床解释可在不引起伴侣警觉的情况下将患者与伴侣分开，降低报复风险。
This creates the required private setting using a non-suspicious workflow and protects the client from possible retaliation.
这样可用不引人怀疑的流程创造所需的私下环境，并保护患者免受可能的报复。
Confronting the partner can escalate danger and is not the nurse's role during screening.
质问伴侣可能使危险升级，也不是护士在筛查阶段的职责。
Pressuring the client is coercive and may increase fear rather than creating safe conditions for disclosure.
逼迫患者解释具有胁迫性，可能增加恐惧，而不是创造安全披露条件。
Screening in the suspected abuser's presence is unsafe and may prevent honest disclosure.
在疑似施暴者在场时筛查不安全，也可能阻止患者如实披露。
When abuse is suspected, the first safe step is privacy without alerting the suspected abuser.
怀疑虐待时，第一步是安全地创造隐私，同时不要惊动疑似施暴者。
Stage 1: Complete the statement describing the nurse's best response to the client's request for a promise of secrecy.
第1阶段：补全句子，说明护士对患者要求保密承诺的最佳回应。
The nurse should {{1}} and explain that the disclosure will be {{2}}.
护士应{{1}}，并解释该披露内容将{{2}}。
call the partner back into the room to clarify the account
叫伴侣回到房间以澄清事情经过
avoid promising absolute confidentiality and describe the limits honestly
避免承诺绝对保密，并如实说明保密界限
promise that no one else will be told
保证不会告诉任何其他人
tell the client that the nurse cannot continue unless she agrees to police involvement
告诉患者除非同意警方介入，否则护士不能继续处理
shared with the clinical team for safety planning and not disclosed to her partner
为安全计划与临床团队共享，但不会透露给她的伴侣
automatically sent to her partner through the after-visit summary
通过离诊总结自动发送给她的伴侣
reported to law enforcement in every adult IPV disclosure
每次成年患者披露亲密伴侣暴力时都报告给执法部门
left out of the medical record so no one can access it
不写入病历，这样任何人都无法看到

The nurse should not promise absolute secrecy. The case protocol requires documentation and provider notification for safety planning, while also protecting the client from disclosure to the partner and avoiding law-enforcement contact unless a stated reporting trigger is present.
护士不应承诺绝对保密。病例流程要求为安全计划进行记录并通知医疗服务提供者，同时也要保护患者，不向伴侣披露；除非存在病例中列出的报告触发条件，否则不联系执法部门。

The correct first phrase is to avoid an absolute confidentiality promise and explain limits honestly; promises of total secrecy are misleading because documentation and provider involvement are required.
第一个空的正确内容是避免承诺绝对保密并如实说明界限；绝对保密的承诺具有误导性，因为需要记录并让提供者参与。

The correct second phrase is sharing only with the clinical team for safety planning and not with the partner. Automatic partner disclosure, universal police reporting, or omitting documentation would conflict with the case protocol.
第二个空的正确内容是仅为安全计划与临床团队共享，不告知伴侣。自动向伴侣披露、一律报警或不记录，都与病例流程相冲突。
Do not promise absolute confidentiality. State who must know for care, what will not be disclosed, and which specific reporting triggers apply.
不要承诺绝对保密。说明哪些人因护理需要必须知情、哪些信息不会被披露，以及哪些具体情况会触发报告义务。
Stage 2: The client reports that her 3-year-old son has witnessed the partner pushing and grabbing her. Which response is most appropriate?
第2阶段：患者报告3岁儿子曾目睹伴侣推搡、抓拽她。哪项回应最合适？
Consult the provider and follow state child-welfare reporting requirements if the child's exposure meets reporting criteria.
与医疗服务提供者沟通；若孩子目睹暴力符合报告标准，则按州儿童福利报告要求处理。
Call law enforcement immediately because every adult IPV disclosure must be reported to police.
立即报警，因为每次成年患者披露亲密伴侣暴力都必须报告警方。
Explain that there is no child-safety concern because the child has not been directly struck.
解释说孩子没有被直接打到，所以不存在儿童安全问题。
Warn the client that she will lose custody if she does not leave the relationship today.
警告患者如果今天不离开这段关系，就会失去孩子监护权。

The case protocol names suspected child abuse or neglect as a mandatory-reporting trigger. A child witnessing domestic violence may create a child-welfare concern, so the nurse should involve the provider and follow applicable reporting requirements while communicating transparently and non-punitively with the client.
病例流程将疑似儿童虐待或忽视列为强制报告触发条件。儿童目睹家庭暴力可能构成儿童福利风险，因此护士应让医疗服务提供者参与，并按适用报告要求处理，同时以透明、非惩罚性的方式与患者沟通。
This distinguishes adult IPV reporting from a potential child-welfare trigger and keeps the response aligned with the stated protocol.
这一区分了成年亲密伴侣暴力报告与潜在儿童福利触发条件，并与病例流程保持一致。
The case states that adult IPV is not automatically reported to law enforcement without consent unless a specific trigger applies.
病例说明，除非有特定触发条件，成年亲密伴侣暴力不会在患者不同意时自动报告给执法部门。
Exposure to violence can still raise a child-safety concern even if the child has not been directly struck.
即使孩子未被直接殴打，目睹暴力也可能构成儿童安全风险。
Threatening the client is punitive, unsafe, and may increase disengagement from prenatal care.
威胁患者具有惩罚性且不安全，可能使其不再接受产前护理。
Separate adult autonomy from child-safety reporting. The same IPV disclosure can require different actions when a child may be at risk.
区分成年人自主权与儿童安全报告。同一亲密伴侣暴力披露在儿童可能受影响时，可能需要不同处理。
Stage 2: The client says she is not ready to leave and asks, 'Do you think I'm a bad mother?' Which nursing responses are appropriate? Select all that apply.
第2阶段：患者说她还没准备好离开，并问：'你觉得我是个坏母亲吗？'哪些护理回应合适？请选择所有适用项。
Say, 'The abuse is not your fault, and asking for help does not make you a bad mother.'
说：'遭受虐待不是你的错，寻求帮助并不表示你是坏母亲。'
Tell her that leaving is her decision and that the team can help with safety planning and resources.
告诉她离开与否由她决定，团队可以协助安全计划和资源安排。
Explore safe contacts, transportation barriers, essential documents, and ways to hide resources safely.
了解安全联系人、交通障碍、重要证件，以及如何安全隐藏资源。
Advise her to stop prenatal care until she is willing to separate from the partner.
建议她在愿意与伴侣分开之前暂停产前护理。
Tell her she must leave today because staying means she is choosing the abuse.
告诉她今天必须离开，因为留下就等于选择继续受虐。
Offer discreet resource information without requiring her to call a hotline during the visit.
提供隐蔽的资源信息，但不要求她在本次就诊时拨打热线。

Patient-centered IPV care affirms that abuse is not the client's fault, respects her autonomy, and offers safety planning and resources without forcing immediate separation. Practical safety planning is especially important because the partner controls finances, monitors the phone, and limits transportation.
以患者为中心的亲密伴侣暴力护理应肯定受虐不是患者的错，尊重其自主权，并在不强迫立即分开的情况下提供安全计划和资源。由于伴侣控制经济、监控手机并限制交通，实际可行的安全计划尤其重要。
A discreet card respects her readiness and reduces digital-tracking risk compared with forcing a call or sending links.
隐蔽资源卡尊重患者当前准备程度，并比强迫拨打电话或发送链接更能降低数字监控风险。
This validates the client, reduces shame, and avoids blaming her for the abuse.
这能肯定患者、减轻羞耻感，并避免把受虐责任归咎于她。
These are practical components of a preliminary safety plan tailored to the client's barriers.
这些是根据患者障碍制定初步安全计划的实际组成部分。
Respecting autonomy helps maintain trust and ongoing prenatal care while supporting safer options.
尊重自主权有助于维持信任和持续产前护理，同时支持更安全的选择。
Stopping prenatal care would reduce maternal-fetal monitoring and isolates the client further.
暂停产前护理会减少母胎监测，并使患者更加孤立。
Pressuring immediate departure can increase danger and may cause the client to disengage from care.
强迫立即离开可能增加危险，并可能使患者不再接受护理。
Avoid judgmental or coercive IPV responses. Choose options that validate, preserve autonomy, and build a realistic safety plan.
避免评判性或胁迫性的亲密伴侣暴力回应。选择能肯定患者、维护自主权并建立现实安全计划的选项。
Stage 3: The client asks whether the disclosure will be in her chart and whether her partner can see it. Which nursing actions are appropriate? Select all that apply.
第3阶段：患者询问披露内容是否会写入病历，以及伴侣是否能看到。哪些护理行动合适？请选择所有适用项。
Document the disclosure using the client's own words for continuity of care and safety planning.
使用患者原话记录披露内容，以便连续护理和安全计划。
Use only the contact method the client identifies as safe and provide discreet written resource information.
只使用患者确认安全的联系方式，并提供隐蔽的书面资源信息。
Leave a detailed voicemail about IPV resources on the primary phone number listed in the chart.
在病历中登记的主要电话号码上留下关于亲密伴侣暴力资源的详细语音留言。
Send IPV resource links through the patient portal because electronic health records are automatically safe from partner monitoring.
通过患者门户发送亲密伴侣暴力资源链接，因为电子健康记录自动不受伴侣监控。
Explain that protected health information generally is not released to the partner without the client's authorization, while also assessing practical access risks.
解释受保护健康信息通常不会在患者未授权时提供给伴侣，同时评估实际访问风险。
Ask whether the partner has portal access, proxy access, shared-device access, insurance-document access, or access to her phone before sending messages or links.
在发送消息或链接前，询问伴侣是否能访问患者门户、代理权限、共用设备、保险文件或她的手机。

The disclosure should be documented for clinical continuity, but the nurse must address the realistic ways an abuser may access information, including portal credentials, proxy access, shared devices, insurance documents, and monitored phones. The nurse should use only client-approved safe contact methods and avoid unsafe electronic communication.
披露内容应被记录以保证临床连续性，但护士必须处理施暴者可能获取信息的实际途径，包括患者门户账号、代理访问、共用设备、保险文件和被监控手机。护士应只使用患者认可的安全联系方式，并避免不安全的电子沟通。
This gives accurate confidentiality guidance while acknowledging that practical access may differ from formal authorization.
这既提供准确的保密说明，也承认实际访问风险可能不同于正式授权。
This directly addresses the technology and document-access risks described in the case.
这直接处理了病例中描述的技术和文件访问风险。
Documentation supports continuity of care and safety planning; omitting the disclosure can compromise future care.
记录有助于连续护理和安全计划；省略披露内容可能影响后续护理。
Portal messages may be unsafe if the partner monitors the portal, device, or credentials.
如果伴侣监控患者门户、设备或登录信息，患者门户消息可能不安全。
Client-identified safe contact methods and discreet written information support safety without forcing digital exposure.
患者确认安全的联系方式和隐蔽书面信息，有助于保障安全且避免被数字监控暴露。
A detailed voicemail on an unsafe number can disclose the IPV concern and increase danger.
在不安全号码上留下详细语音可能暴露亲密伴侣暴力问题并增加危险。
Confidentiality is not only a legal concept; in IPV care, always assess practical access to phones, portals, devices, and paperwork.
保密不仅是法律概念；在亲密伴侣暴力护理中，始终评估手机、患者门户、设备和文件的实际访问风险。
Stage 3: The partner returns and asks, 'Everything okay? What took so long?' Which response by the nurse best protects the client's safety?
第3阶段：伴侣回来后问：'一切都好吗？怎么这么久？'护士哪项回应最能保护患者安全？
'Nothing happened. Ask her why she made the visit take so long.'
'没发生什么。你问她为什么让就诊拖这么久。'
'We had routine lab work and screening to review today, and we talked about some third-trimester planning.'
'今天我们复查了一些常规实验室检查和筛查内容，也谈了一些孕晚期计划。'
'Her blood pressure is dangerously high, so the visit took longer.'
'她的血压非常危险，所以就诊时间久了一些。'
'She told me where the bruises came from, and we need to talk with you about it.'
'她告诉我瘀伤是怎么来的，我们需要和你谈谈这件事。'

A truthful but non-revealing response normalizes the length of the visit without disclosing the IPV screening. It avoids alerting the partner and avoids fabricating a medical complication that could create further problems.
真实但不透露隐私的回应可以把较长就诊时间正常化，同时不披露亲密伴侣暴力筛查内容。这样既避免惊动伴侣，也避免编造可能带来后续问题的医疗并发症。
Disclosing the bruising discussion to the partner could place the client at immediate risk.
向伴侣透露关于瘀伤的讨论可能使患者立即处于危险中。
Fabricating a dangerous blood-pressure problem is dishonest and may create unnecessary follow-up questions or conflict.
编造危险血压问题不诚实，也可能引发不必要的追问或冲突。
This is accurate, routine, and does not reveal the disclosure or increase the partner's suspicion.
这项回应准确、常规，不透露披露内容，也不会增加伴侣怀疑。
Deflecting blame to the client may increase partner suspicion and does not protect safety.
把责任推给患者可能增加伴侣怀疑，不能保护安全。
When the suspected abuser returns, choose a response that is truthful, routine, calm, and non-revealing.
疑似施暴者返回时，选择真实、常规、冷静且不透露隐私的回应。
